text:
Mara (Growth): Putting together the newsletter nurture for the Spring rollout. Two goals: webinar signups + benchmark reads. Need decisions on segmentation, subject line strategy, and the follow-up drip.
Diego: I uploaded the HTML mockups to the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/newsletter-mockups. Two hero layouts (webinar-first, benchmark-first).
Katherine (Demand Gen): Recommend splitting audience into: Engage (active users last 14d), Passive (accounts with API calls but low recent volume), Trials (console trials), and Sales Hot (crm score >=80).
Mara (Growth): Good. Plan: primary split Engage vs Passive for the A/B subject test; Trials and Sales Hot get a tailored subject.
Tomas (Analytics): Proposed subjects: 1) "See how top apps cut inference cost by 3x" (metrics-first) 2) "Join our Spring product walk-through" (event-first). Suggest holdout 5% control for lift measurement.
Diego: A/B setup: 40/40/15/5 across creative variants + control. We'll tag with headers: X-Email-Test and include variant id in UTM.
Katherine (Demand Gen): CTA options: a) Register for live demo (primary) b) Download one-pager benchmark (secondary) c) Request SDR intro (enterprise only).
Mara (Growth): We'll multi-arm: primary CTA = Register, secondary inline link to benchmark. Enterprise recipients should see SDR intro button.
SendBot: Running suppression & scoring pass now...
SendBot: Preliminary counts after suppression: Engage=9,876, Passive=6,230, Trials=3,009, Sales Hot=642, Total=19,757. Suppression details: 4.1% invalid, 1.2% recent bounces excluded.
Tomas (Analytics): Tracking: utm_source=news&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=spring_rollout_2025&utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Add click event for CTA and a custom event for "benchmark_download".
Diego: Timing: NA send Tue 09:30 PT, EMEA send Wed 10:30 CET. Webinar times: live NA 11:00 PT; EMEA get live replay + 1-week on-demand.
Katherine (Demand Gen): Drip plan for engaged openers: Day0 invite, Day3 benchmark recap, Day7 case study + SDR nudge for Sales Hot. Non-openers: Day2 subject tweak resend, Day6 final reminder.
Mara (Growth): Add a one-question intent button in the email: "Are you interested in a call? Yes / Maybe" - clicks will route to an intent queue.
Diego: Preheader options: "Benchmark inside: latency & cost for production LLMs" or "RSVP: Spring product walk-through". I prefer preheader to match subject variant.
Tomas (Analytics): We'll evaluate winner at 36 hours and auto-send winner creative to remaining recipients. Use open rate and register conversion as primary metrics.
Katherine (Demand Gen): Can we include a short beta quote from a named customer? Compliance sign-off required but it boosts CTR.
Mara (Growth): Yes, include a 15-word quote. Katherine to confirm legal OK.
SendBot: Suppression pass complete. Final send counts: Engage 9,432, Passive 5,991, Trials 2,870, Sales Hot 618, Total 18,911.
Diego: Checklist before scheduling: 1) Final copy locked 2) Images optimized 3) UTMs + headers 4) ESP variant mapping 5) Suppression verified 6) Webinar reg page health check 7) Deliverability monitor channel.
Mara (Growth): Owners: Diego (creative + ESP), Tomas (tracking + analytics), Katherine (segmentation + legal), Mara (overall). Deadline: finalize by Mon 4pm PT.
Katherine (Demand Gen): I'll add GDPR-compliant footer text and the privacy blurb about segmentation. Dropping text into the doc now.
Mara (Growth): If no blockers we schedule A/B for Tue 09:30 PT. :rocket:
Diego: I'll prepare the campaign in ESP and send a dry run to team.
Tomas (Analytics): I'll build the dashboard and the winner automation script.
SendBot: Reminder scheduled: deliverability monitor will post status to #deliverability during window.
Mara (Growth): Thanks team, meeting Mon 2pm for final QA.
Katherine (Demand Gen): Thanks all! :tada:
